verdict.line: You lose if you get caught against a wall or eat the full Bellows Breath gout into an all-in; you win if you farm clean behind your W shield and let Enrage's permanent HP gain snowball you past him.

brief.thesis: This is a 44.9% win rate over 107 games on an otherwise 49.6% champion, and OP.GG's own read is that both sides mostly farm but can burst each other down. The structural fact is that Ornn's kill pressure comes from a single terrain-dependent combo (E into a wall) and a telegraphed W, while Sion's kill pressure comes from stacking permanent max HP off CS through E and landing Q when Ornn is caught in range 550.

theirWindow.when: you're near a wall and E is up
theirWindow.what: Searing Charge only knocks up if Ornn hits terrain while charging, so if he has E up and you're pinned against a wall he can dash into you, knock you up, and follow with Q slow and the W Brittle gout for a real trade. Back off terrain when his E cooldown (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) is close to ready.

yourWindow.when: his Q and E are both down
yourWindow.what: With Volcanic Rupture (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s) and Searing Charge both on cooldown, Ornn has no slow and no knockup to punish an approach. Pop W (Death's Caress) for the shield, walk in, and use Q (Cryptic Gaze, 550 range) to stun him into a free trade or a detonated W explosion.

start.why: The 55% pick rate option (44.2% WR over 77 games) — the passive damage reduction and regen blunt Ornn's Q poke while you farm through early trades.

boots.why: 48.8% pick rate at 48.4% WR — the tenacity shortens how long you're slowed after a Volcanic Rupture hit or stuck Brittle from his W, and the magic resist directly answers his magic damage.

core.why: The shared first item across every listed build path — its HP stacking directly compounds with Enrage's permanent max-HP-on-kill passive.
Picked second in the most-run path (8% pick, 42.9% WR) — the magic resist and AoE burn answer Ornn's all-magic-damage kit.
Rounds out the core path — more HP and damage reduction to survive his E/W engage windows while your stacks grow.

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher win-rate page (52.4% over 14.6% pick) — Grasp's permanent health growth on proc stacks directly with Enrage's HP-to-AD conversion, making every trade cheaper over the lane.

summoners.why: The standard pick at 83.9% (49.2% WR). Flash lets you dodge Searing Charge's wall setup or close the gap for a Q stun; Teleport resets you after shoving a wave with Enrage stacks and lets you answer Ornn's global-threat R from a sidelane.

playing.title: Shield before you extend
playing.detail: Pop W (Death's Caress) before pushing for a cannon wave or standing in Searing Charge/Bellows Breath range — the shield absorbs the hit and still explodes for damage if it survives.

playing.title: Stay off walls
playing.detail: Searing Charge only knocks you up if Ornn connects with terrain mid-dash. Fight him in open lane and his E becomes a harmless poke dash.

playing.title: Dodge the final gout
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to avoid his W while farming — getting hit by the last tick of Bellows Breath applies Brittle, which turns his next hit into a real trade.

playing.title: Farm for the HP stacks
playing.detail: Enrage permanently raises your max HP on every unit kill, so uninterrupted CS is itself a power spike — prioritize safe farm over forcing trades before level 6.

playing.title: Punish his cooldown gaps
playing.detail: When both Volcanic Rupture and Searing Charge are down, walk up and land Q (Cryptic Gaze, 550 range) for the stun — he has no tool left to punish the approach.

playing.title: Save R for his all-in windows
playing.detail: Cannibalism is a 90s cooldown — hold it for level 6, 11, and 16 spikes or jungler-assisted ganks where Ornn tries to force a fight, not for routine farming.

playing.title: Use Teleport to answer his R
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God has 2500 range and can zone or gank from across the map; Teleport lets you reset top or answer the play it sets up elsewhere.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate/sample-size figures are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG. The tactical reasoning — shield timing, wall dependency on Searing Charge, cooldown-window trading — is this brief's own analysis of the listed ability mechanics.
